data.exact_reserve_text: The provisions for these claims established at the previous year-end compared to the present estimated ultimate costs of these claims has enabled a release of reserves as at 31 December 2014 of GBP 16.7m (2013: GBP 10.0m release). GBP 8.1m of this release relates to the class of business fire and other damage to property.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Claims arising out of Superstorm Sandy are described as stable and as expected; not a material source of adverse development.

named_events.loss_description: claims arising out of Superstorm Sandy are stable and as expected

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the syndicate recorded a gross release of prior year reserves of GBP 16.7m driven by very favourable incurred claims development on prior years (notably 2011 and earlier). Of the total release, GBP 8.1m relates to fire and other damage to property. The report notes that claims from 2012 events such as Superstorm Sandy were stable and as expected.
raw_causal_phrases: substantial release of reserves for prior years now available due to the very favourable trends experienced during 2014 in incurred claims development on all the years of 2011 and prior.
The utilisation of the reserve for incurred but not reported claims has been lighter than in any year of recent times.
enabled a release of reserves as at 31 December 2014 of GBP 16.7m (2013: GBP 10.0m release). GBP 8.1m of this release relates to the class of business fire and other damage to property.
claims arising out of Superstorm Sandy are stable and as expected.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 16.7m release) taken from note text in the financial statement notes; the note does not explicitly label the figure 'gross' but it appears in the Movement discussion and is treated as the gross reserve release. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (prior year comparative). No gross claims development triangle located in the report to cross-check; RITC entries exist elsewhere in the report for closed 2012 year but do not appear to distort the cited prior year release figure.
